description: Kit-owned paths: product consumers must not diverge from upstream without a tracked, justified exception. Prefer design overrides and new product paths over patching the kit.
allowed_product_notes: apps/* is listed so product apps exist; the checker still treats apps/example-* and packages/* as protected. New apps (e.g. apps/share-web) are free.

design_overrides.description: Accepted zero-edit customization of the design system. Do these first; never patch packages/ui for brand tokens.

patterns.how: Keep @import "@gosilex/ui/styles.css" then redeclare CSS variables on :root / .dark (primary, radius, fonts, sidebar, charts). Tokens are the kit extension surface.
Import primitives from @gosilex/ui and compose product shells (LoadingButton, BrandHeader). Do not copy/fork files from packages/ui/src/components.
Point @source at packages/ui and the product app only. App-level utilities stay in the product CSS tree.
Favicon, OG, logo live in the product app — not packages/ui.
